full_name: Mesfin Gebremichael | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Social Sciences Robert G. James Scholar Fellow Institute for Peace and Security Studies, Addis Ababa University (Ethiopia)
bio: During his fellowship at Harvard Radcliffe institute, Mesfin Gebremichael is working to enhance understanding of the political transitions in Ethiopia and Sudan and how populism has contributed to the current political trajectories in the two countries and the wider region.
